title: AutoCoding.id — Indonesian Health Regulation Register
status_policy: Only entries verified as in_force on the checked_on date may be used as active regulatory references. Re-check official JDIH before each release. Superseded instruments are retained only as exclusion metadata and must never be used as active authority.

regulations.title: Kesehatan
regulations.implementation_note: Landasan umum; bukan sumber struktur kode ICD atau aturan pemilihan DU/DS.

regulations.title: Peraturan Pelaksanaan Undang-Undang Nomor 17 Tahun 2023 tentang Kesehatan
regulations.implementation_note: Gunakan hanya untuk konteks ketentuan kesehatan yang relevan; bukan pengganti ICD-10 WHO.

regulations.title: Rekam Medis
regulations.implementation_note: Mengatur penyelenggaraan rekam medis. Tidak menetapkan daftar kode ICD atau otomatis menentukan DU/DS.

regulations.title: Pedoman Indonesian Case Base Groups (INA-CBG) dalam Pelaksanaan Jaminan Kesehatan
regulations.implementation_note: Status JDIH terverifikasi berlaku. Ruang lingkupnya INA-CBG; jangan menyamakan dengan pedoman iDRG atau menganggapnya satu-satunya sumber aturan DU/DS.

regulations.title: Penanggulangan Penyakit
regulations.implementation_note: Rujukan konteks penyakit dan pelaporan. Tidak menggantikan klasifikasi ICD-10 WHO.

regulations.title: Rumah Sakit
regulations.implementation_note: Konteks tata kelola rumah sakit; bukan sumber penetapan kode diagnosis.

excluded_superseded.title: Petunjuk Teknis Sistem Indonesian Case Base Groups (INA-CBGs)
excluded_superseded.reason: Tidak berlaku; dicabut oleh Permenkes 76 Tahun 2016. Jangan gunakan sebagai dasar aktif.

excluded_superseded.title: Pedoman Indonesian Case Base Groups (INA-CBG) dalam Pelaksanaan Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional
excluded_superseded.reason: Tidak berlaku; dicabut oleh Permenkes 26 Tahun 2021. Jangan gunakan sebagai dasar aktif.

operational_rules: Never use excluded_superseded entries as active legal or coding authority.
A regulation may be used only within its verified subject-matter scope.
Do not infer that a regulation about medical records, hospitals, disease control, or payment methodology defines ICD code selection.
WHO ICD-10 remains the classification source for WHO ICD-10 code titles and structure in this application.
Do not label INA-CBG provisions as iDRG provisions.
If a regulation's current status or replacement chain cannot be verified from an official source, mark it status_unverified and exclude it from active decision support.
Store the official source URL and last verification date for every regulation.
